   AMENDMENT 0001   

 Amendment 0001 is hereby issued against Sources Sought Notice W519TC-27-R-B129.Changes:  

 From Original language: 

 Description: The Army Contracting Command–Rock Island (ACC-RI), on behalf of the Project Lead Joint Services (PL JS) and the McAlester Army Ammunition Plant (MCAAP) Directorate of Public Works (DPW), is seeking capable sources for the  design and construction of a modernized facility (Renovation and Modernization of Building 129, Lunch and Locker Room Facility)  capable of supporting consolidated personnel operations at MCAAP while complying with strict Department of Defense physical security, environmental, and facility modernization standards. 

 The United States Government (Government) intends to utilize the information submitted in response to this Sources Sought Notice (SSN) to issue a follow-on  Request for Solutions (RFS)  that will encompass the full requirement for the modernized Building 129 facility. The Government is contemplating using a  Stand-Alone Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under 10 U.S.C. § 2808a (Facility construction or repair: transactions other than contracts and grants)  to satisfy this requirement. This authority allows the Department of Defense to carry out repair and construction projects for facilities outside the traditional Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) framework. However, if the acquisition approach changes, the information obtained from this SSN will be utilized in the planning and award of the project. 

 The Government's intent is to award the proposed transaction(s) based on the capabilities demonstrated in response to the follow-on RFS; therefore, all interested sources shall ensure that they have fully identified, in writing, their capabilities to perform the requirements included in this SSN and subsequent updates. 

 The Government encourages responses from traditional defense contractors, non-traditional defense contractors, construction technology companies, commercial innovators, and consortia, even if they have not previously performed work for the Department of Defense. 

  

 To Revised Language:

 The United States Government (Government) intends to utilize the information submitted in response to this Sources Sought Notice (SSN) to issue a follow-on   solicitation, request for solutions, request for quote   that will encompass the full requirement for the modernized Building 129 facility. 

 The Government is contemplating using a  Stand-Alone Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under 10 U.S.C. § 2808a (Facility construction or repair: transactions other than contracts and grants, 10 U.S.C    § 4022 Authority of the Department of Defense to carry out certain prototype projects, and Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Services  to satisfy this requirement. 

 The Other Transaction authorities allow the Department of War to carry out repair and construction projects for facilities, prototype projects outside the traditional Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) framework.
